def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not all(isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) and arr.ndim == 2 for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D numpy arrays")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number (not boolean)")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized linear decay weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute weighted averages
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ norm_weights
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ norm_weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ norm_weights

    # Margin: improvement of using API with result over no API
    margin = weighted_with - weighted_no
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
